lhe.sign_error_note: Binomial sign fluctuation conditional on the integrated absolute normalization; excludes its integration uncertainty.

comparison.interpretation: Integration errors are Monte Carlo integration uncertainties, not scale/PDF theory uncertainties. Final-event efficiency uses finalized event count divided by all attempted folded phase-space points, including top-ups. Candidate retention is reported separately. AmpliCol final rates use initial fixed-budget production moments, while MINT rates use stage-1 integration. Ratios from incomplete worker subsets are diagnostic only.
